scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional dark palette with coherent blue-gray tones, satisfying blue/orange hover highlighting, and correct label flipping — but default edge opacity (0.25) renders the bundling structure nearly invisible until hover, underselling the technique.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: No quantitative encoding violations — topology-only layout with no baselines, size scales, or axes to misrepresent; tension parameter is honestly exposed, but hardcoded radius and absent key functions in data joins are minor structural weaknesses typical of synthetic-data demos.
scores.stress_test_note: No zoom/brush/transitions or cross-view dispatch, so most stress-test traps are absent; the only real vulnerability is the un-throttled slider input driving expensive path recalculation on every mousemove tick.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Edge bundling and hover-fade interaction effectively manage 80 nodes and ~80 edges — the two-color source/target highlight resolves reading complexity on demand — but label crowding at densely-packed cluster segments (notably top and left arcs) creates a small lookup burden at rest.
